waits.words: The floating island itself: floating islands come with a later Architect release; the monastery buildings are laid out first and the island is offered when it can be built.

answer.summary: A quiet pale-stone monastery of nine buildings: an abbey chapel at the heart, a gatehouse at the edge, three monks' cells, a refectory, a scriptorium, a herb garden and an observatory on the highest point. The floating island and the long stair up to the gatehouse are in the plan but wait for a later Architect release; the buildings are laid out first.
